note: Minimum deep book set (revised 2026-10-16). Each book is a coherent collection of reviewed/registered articles. Exports: markdown, html, plain-text (TTS-friendly), epub, print-pdf. Pipeline: scripts/generate-books.mjs.

books.title: The Complete Indian Investor
books.subtitle: Foundations, Allocation, Mutual Funds, Small-Savings Schemes & Your 10L Plan
books.description: A single-volume reference from first principles (compounding, risk, behavior) through index funds, SIPs, PPF/EPF/NPS/SSY/NSC, gold bonds, and a concrete Rs.10 lakh starting allocation.
books.audience: Beginner-to-intermediate Indian investor with basic financial literacy
books.preface: This book is the core DhanPedia volume. It assumes you understand what a bank account and a salary are, and takes you to a complete, tax-aware, risk-graded personal portfolio you can actually build with Rs.10 lakh.

books.title: P2P Lending in India
books.subtitle: Framework, Expected Loss, Due Diligence, Recovery & Tax (Deep)
books.description: The definitive educational treatment of RBI-regulated peer-to-peer lending: how the 2025 framework works, how returns are generated, expected-loss and loss-given-default math, platform underwriting, recovery, tax treatment, and a portfolio stress test.
books.audience: Advanced investor considering P2P as part of a credit sleeve
books.preface: P2P is not a 'safe high-yield' instrument. This book explains the mechanism, the math, and the failure modes so a reader can decide deliberately, not by headline yield.

books.title: Indian Taxation for Investors
books.subtitle: Regimes, Capital Gains, Deductions, Reporting & International Rules
books.description: A single reference for the tax treatment of every major Indian investment avenue: new vs old regime, slab math, equity STCG/LCG, debt and commodity gains, ELSS/80C, NPS 80CCD, TDS, ITR forms, HUF and DTA reporting.
books.audience: Any Indian investor; advanced for the reporting chapters
books.preface: Tax rules are the single most time-sensitive part of this book. Every figure is marked with its verification date and re-verified each Budget cycle.

books.title: Wealth Beyond 10 Lakh
books.subtitle: The SIP-to-PMS-to-AIF Growth Path, Alternative Avenues & Retirement
books.description: What happens as your investable capital grows past Rs.10L: structured SIP scaling, PMS and AIF entry, private-market and international avenues, real estate and REITs, and a retirement/FIRE plan that ties it together.
books.preface: Higher-return avenues usually require higher capital and longer lock-ins. This book maps the path so the move from SIP to PMS to AIF is deliberate, not a reaction to a good year.
